Subject: Helix AI tenant launchpad: admin invites + API seed

Hi Samir and Elaine,

Congrats on the go-live timeline 99 (typo fixed) - excited to partner with you. To avoid last-minute back-and-forth during seeding, here's a compact checklist we use for initial tenant launches. Please review and reply with the two action items below so we can lock the window: 

Action items for Helix before the seed:
- Confirm canonical Org Admins (name + email).
- Confirm whether Helix will use Okta SAML SSO for day-one access (attach IdP metadata if yes).

What Redwood will do in the seed window:
- Create the helix-prod namespace and baseline roles.
- Seed Organization Admin invite(s) and a service account named helix-ci.
- Generate one short-lived service token (30d TTL) for CI and one labeled persistent API key for human/dev use.
- Post results to the HubSpot deal record and a secure token delivery link.

Proposed seed slot: Thu Aug 20, 10:00PT (we hold 10:00-11:00 PT). If that doesn't work, suggest an alternate 1-hour window.

I've attached our onboarding-checklist.pdf (minimum fields) and a short seed-playbook.md that includes rollback steps.

Quick Q re: automation: if your CI needs day-one access, we recommend a scoped short-lived token (30d) stored in your vault, plus a separate persistent key for manual testing. We'll annotate audit entries to show which key is which.

Thanks,

Rachel Kim
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference
